    pts=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: pts.append((r,c,v))
    if len(pts)!=3:return out
    # activate only the lower-right right-triangle orientation
    a=[p for p in pts if any(q[0]<p[0] and q[1]==p[1] for q in pts) and any(q[1]<p[1] and q[0]==p[0] for q in pts)]
    if len(a)!=1:return out
    corner=a[0]; r,c,_=corner
    top=[p for p in pts if p[1]==c and p[0]<r]
    left=[p for p in pts if p[0]==r and p[1]<c]
    if len(top)!=1 or len(left)!=1:return out
    t=top[0]; l=left[0]
    if r-t[0] != c-l[1]: return out
    d=r-t[0]
    if d<4:return out
    k=d//? 
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if len(pts)!=3:return out
    for cr,cc,cv in pts:
      top=[p for p in pts if p[1]==cc and p[0]<cr]
      left=[p for p in pts if p[0]==cr and p[1]<cc]
      if len(top)==1 and len(left)==1 and cr-top[0][0]==cc-left[0][1]:
        d=cr-top[0][0]
        if d<4:return out
        x=3*d//8
        pos=[(top[0][0]+x,top[0][1]+x,top[0][2]),(left[0][0]-x,left[0][1]+x,left[0][2]),(cr-x,cc-x,cv)]
        for r,c,v in pos: out[r][c]=v
        # midpoint of hypotenuse endpoints, colored 5
        p=pos[0]; q=pos[1]
        out[(p[0]+q[0])//2][(p[1]+q[1])//2]=5
        return out
    return out"}
